course_title: Special Topics in Japanese: Exploring Japanese through New
subject: JPN
course_description: Study of Japanese language, literature, society, thought, or culture, alone or in conjunction with other literary or cultural trends. Topics to be announced in advance.
course_notes: JPN 102 or equivalent level of Japanese language comprehension is required for the class. This course invites students to discover contemporary Japan through authentic news articles and broadcasts. Unlike sequenced language courses organized around textbook chapters and grammar points, this course uses engaging real-world topics to strengthen reading and listening skills, expand vocabulary and kanji knowledge, and explore daily life and contemporary issues in Japan. Students will use news as a gateway to language, culture, and communication. Students should be comfortable reading short authentic texts and know approximately 500¿800 commonly used kanji. Please contact the instructor if you are unsure whether the course is right for you.
